rows.input: How do I cancel my subscription? I'm on Android.

citations.quote: Subscriptions bought on Android are managed by Google Play. Steps: 1. Open the Google Play Store app. 2. Tap your profile icon, then Payments & subscriptions, then Subscriptions. 3. Select Nebula and tap Cancel subscription.

rows.summary: Customer is asking how to cancel their Nebula subscription on Android.

replies.formal: We understand you would like to cancel your subscription. Subscriptions purchased on Android are managed through Google Play. To cancel, please open the Google Play Store app, tap your profile icon, go to Payments & subscriptions, select Subscriptions, choose Nebula, and tap Cancel subscription. Please note that deleting the app does not cancel your subscription. Nebula Support Team
replies.empathetic: It can be frustrating to navigate subscription settings, but we are here to help you cancel your Android plan. Since subscriptions bought on Android are managed by Google Play, please open the Google Play Store app, tap your profile icon, go to Payments & subscriptions, select Subscriptions, choose Nebula, and tap Cancel subscription. Remember that simply deleting the app will not stop the renewals. Nebula Support Team
replies.short: To cancel your Android subscription, open the Google Play Store app, tap your profile icon, go to Payments & subscriptions > Subscriptions, select Nebula, and tap Cancel subscription. Nebula Support Team

citations.quote: You can request deletion of your account and personal data at any time. Deletion requests and data access (export) requests are handled by the Privacy team and are completed within 30 days, as required by GDPR.

Support agents do not delete data themselves. They confirm the request, verify the account owner and forward the case to the Privacy team.

rows.input: Die App stürzt bei jedem Start ab, ich habe sie schon neu installiert.

citations.quote: 1. Restart your device. 2. Update the app to the latest version. 3. Clear the app cache (Android: Settings > Apps > Nebula > Storage > Clear cache). 4. Reinstall the app and log in with the same account; purchases are restored automatically.
If the app is completely unusable for a paying customer after these steps, support escalates the case to the Tech team as P1 and collects device model, OS version and app version.

reasons: model: The customer reported that the app crashes on every launch despite reinstalling, which requires collecting device details and escalating the case to the Tech team as P1.
rows.summary: Der Kunde meldet, dass die App bei jedem Start abstürzt, auch nach einer Neuinstallation.

replies.formal: Guten Tag, es tut uns leid zu hören, dass Sie Probleme mit der App haben. Bitte starten Sie Ihr Gerät neu und stellen Sie sicher, dass Sie die neueste Version der App installiert haben. Falls das Problem weiterhin besteht, teilen Sie uns bitte Ihr Gerätemodell, Ihre Betriebssystemversion und die App-Version mit. Nebula Support Team
replies.empathetic: Wir verstehen, wie frustrierend es ist, wenn die App nicht startet. Bitte versuchen Sie als Nächstes, Ihr Gerät neu zu starten und den App-Cache zu leeren. Wenn das Problem weiterhin besteht, lassen Sie uns bitte Ihr Gerätemodell und die Betriebssystemversion wissen, damit wir Ihnen weiterhelfen können. Nebula Support Team
replies.short: Bitte starten Sie Ihr Gerät neu und prüfen Sie auf App-Updates. Falls der Absturz anhält, senden Sie uns Ihr Gerätemodell und die Betriebssystemversion. Nebula Support Team
